name: System Hardening
summary: Tamper protection for users, SSH, cron, services and system files, a malware process guard, and a security compliance check.
description: Watches the places attackers use to keep access to a server: user accounts, SSH keys, cron jobs, systemd services, shell start-up files, the dynamic linker and system binaries. Each area can be monitored (alert on any change) or locked against changes. A process guard finds miners and programs running from temporary folders, a compliance check scores the server against hardening best practice with one-click fixes, and the log audit lists sign-ins, sudo use and account changes.
features: User, SSH, cron, service and start-up file protection
Monitor or lock mode per area
Process guard (miners, temp-folder binaries, reverse shells)
Alerts through the panel's alert channels
